race.comment: Open race to close out the card. BRIGINSHAW (14) hasn't done much wrong to start the career with a win and two placings from three spins and is drawn to get a gun run in transit from the inside marble. Winning rider Fry retains the mount and looks to have plenty of upside. Sure to prove very hard to toss. FABULEAN (12) resumes here but the form she showed last campaign was good enough for a race of this nature. Can run a big race while fresh. NORTHERNONTAP (10) saves his best form for this course and distance and may play a role from the low draw. DALT JAZ (2) gets Wiggins on board to navigate from the sticky alley and can feature with any luck in running. BANG STICK (3) best of the rest while fresh.
